# "Unhardcode FMV" from the Cutscenes Restored mod (rudiger__gb, The Calculator,
# AnimatedSwine37; https://gamebanana.com/mods/402145), as psp_recomp patch lines.
# A flow-script BGM call with id 0x2NN plays ms0:/PSP/P3P/FMV/NN.pmsf through
# the game's own movie player; only START skips a movie. ADDI (opcode 0x08)
# is rewritten as ADDIU: the recompiler and its interpreter have no ADDI, and
# none of these additions can overflow. Inert without the mod's event scripts.
